4. Handler implementation that handles PRC requests and calls into

4. Handler implementation that handles PRC requests and calls into
**Local Implementation**

head_commit.message:
Skip guardian prewarm during active reviews

Only run guardian trunk prewarm when the session can immediately acquire
review_lock, and hold that lock through the warmup so a real guardian
review cannot race the same session state in parallel.
